backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, signup with role validation, and role-based access control with admin allowlisting.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence mapping UI changes and authentication behavior requirements to affected frontend files with metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file for documentation or tooling.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook outlining steps, troubleshooting, and notes for safe redeploys without code changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark theme variables for the design system.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entrypoint loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router and app flow managing authentication, profile setup gating, and admin-protected routes.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI screen shown when a user without admin rights attempts to access a restricted page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header with navigation, admin-only Users link, and logout handling based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper providing header, content area, and footer for consistent structure.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login screen using Internet Identity with signup and login buttons and a loading state.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: User signup form with validation, role selection, and submission via signupWithCode mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages backend actor instances tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, managing login, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, signup, profile updates, user listing, deletion, and legacy purge.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus custom color variables for light and dark industrial-themed UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing users, deleting accounts, and purging legacy data with permission checks and dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single service report, handling loading, error, and data states with navigation back to history.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Provides a form to create a new service report with validation, submission handling, and success feedback.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a searchable and filterable list of all service reports with navigation to create new entries or view details.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Contains validation helpers for signup form fields including required checks, email, mobile number, and admin code validation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting both query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, animations, containers, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current features, pending requests, and versioned state information.
